decisions.change: Swap the double-deck buses on route R4 with the standard buses on route R1 between 06:30 and 09:00.
decisions.cost_note: No extra bus and no extra driver.

effect.assumption: the same passengers board at the same times; only the vehicles change

evidence.label: Largest load on the fullest trip
Largest load on the emptiest R4 trip

decisions.title: Put the big bus where the people are
decisions.why: The forecast puts more people on R1 than its buses seat, while R4's larger buses run mostly empty in the same hours.

decisions.change: After 21:00, make three R4 stops request stops: the bus calls there when a passenger asks from the stop or from the bus.
decisions.cost_note: A request button or a tap in the app at each stop.

effect.assumption: 25 seconds saved for each stop the bus no longer slows for

evidence.label: Stop visits where the door did not open

decisions.title: Stop only when someone is there
decisions.why: At these stops and hours the forecast says nobody boards or alights on most visits.

decisions.change: Offer Khutwa points to passengers at this stop who take route R2 from a stop nearby, or travel 20 minutes earlier.
decisions.cost_note: Points worth a few dirhams for each passenger who shifts.

effect.assumption: 8 in 100 passengers who get the offer take it (trials in San Francisco and Singapore found about 7 to 10 in 100: docs/research/research-methods.md, section 6)

evidence.label: Forecast boardings at the stop in the peak hour
Free seats on route R2 within 400 metres in the same hour

decisions.title: Reward the passenger who takes the emptier bus
decisions.why: The forecast shows more passengers than seats here, and spare seats a short walk away.
